The '''T-47 airspeeder''' was a popular model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. Designed for industrial cargo hauling, the T-47 was commonly adapted for combat duty. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made heavy use of modified T-47s, including adapting them for cold-weather duty dubbed "[[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]".

==Description==
===Original specifications===
Manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], the T-47 was a basic [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model. Designed for operation inside a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the T-47 was intended to be used for industrial cargo hauling,<ref name="NEGVV" /> [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] [[Spacetug/Legends|towing]],<ref name="ARCore">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> personal transportation, and [[Courier/Legends|courier]] duties.<ref name="FF28" /> The craft was crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[cargo manager]]. The forward-facing pilot controlled the craft, while the rear-facing cargo manager was responsible for using the airspeeder's [[power harpoon launcher]]. The power harpoon could launch a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] tow cable that was attached to cargo modules.<ref name="NEGVV" />

It employed a conventional<ref name="NEGVV" /> and reliable [[Karydee]] [[KD49 repulsorlift drive unit]] paired with a [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[5i.2 high-powered ion drive afterburner]]. As with the majority of Incom's products, the T-47 was designed with end-user modification in mind due to the varied nature of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] industrial and commercial economies. As such, the craft generated a large amount of power, employed a modular design philosophy, had a number of redundant electrical systems,<ref name="EECore" /> and included universal [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] and modular data input.<ref name="ARCore" /> Because of these features, the T-47 could handle the weight and power demands of aftermarket modifications. Incom sold a number of modification packages themselves, and others were produced by smaller manufacturers.<ref name="EECore" />

===Combat modifications===
Officially, Incom Corporation denied any rumors that the T-47 was being used in a combat capacity using aftermarket modifications. Nevertheless, several paramilitary and insurgent groups were known to have modified the T-47 for combat duty.<ref name="EECore" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] began adapting the vehicles for combat duty, their first task was to arm the craft with twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The cargo manager position was converted into a dedicated [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] seat. The gunner used computerized targeting systems and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projection displays and controlled both the forward-facing laser cannons and the rear-mounted harpoon gun, although the pilot was capable of taking control of the lasers. [[Armor/Legends|Armor]] plating was added to the T-47, although the speeder lacked any [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="NEGVV" />

==History==
[[File:T-47_airspeeder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A T-47 airspeeder modified as a snowspeeder]]
Incom's T-47 was a popular airspeeder throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], favored by young pilots.<ref name="FF28" /> During the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] modified a number of T-47s for combat service. T-47s were deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and other worlds to perform reconnaissance.<ref name="NEGVV" />

When the Alliance relocated to the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Rebel [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] worked to adapt the T-47s stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to operate in cold weather. After further extensive modifications, the T-47s were successfully deployed on Hoth, becoming known as "snowspeeders."<ref name="NEGVV" /> Following the Battle of Hoth, the T-47 continued to be used by the Rebel Alliance and the harpoon-and-tow cable tactic was employed in other battles, including the [[Battle of Kothlis|Battle]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="RSII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

==Variants==
Further modifications were made to the T-47s, adapting them for specific environments.<ref name="NEGVV" />

===Snowspeeder===
{{Main|Snowspeeder/Legends}}
The [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] was a modified version of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] T-47 airspeeder. Adapted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for combat duty on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], snowspeeders were integral to the Alliance's defence of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="EGVV" />

===Sandspeeder===
{{Main|T-47 sandspeeder/Legends}}
The [[T-47 sandspeeder/Legends|T-47 sandspeeder]] was a variant of the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] T-47 airspeeder utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in desert conditions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Arda I">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>

===Swampspeeder===
{{Main|Swampspeeder}}
[[Swampspeeder]]s were T-47 airspeeders adapted to serve in [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] environments or swamp [[Planet/Legends|planets]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

===Skyspeeder===
{{Main|Skyspeeder (airspeeder)}}
[[Skyspeeder (airspeeder)|Skyspeeders]] were T-47 airspeeders adapted to serve in high-altitude environments by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

===Aquaspeeder===
{{Main|Combat Aquaspeeder}}
[[Hydrospeare Corporation]]'s [[Combat Aquaspeeder]] was an aquatic design based on the T-47 airspeeder. As a part of the "modification packages" from Hydrospeare, the company's [[Design Team Beta]] took the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] design and made it aquatic.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kenner Products|Kenner]] had planned to make a desert-based version of the T-47 airspeeder called the Sandspeeder, colored orange and red, although the toy's production had been cancelled.<ref name="Blospot">{{Blogspot|subdomain=jjpandemonium|url=2005/12/look-inside-kenners-aborted-star-wars.html|name=Jeff & Jeff's Pandemonium|text=A Look Inside Kenner's Aborted Star Wars Plans for 1985 & 1986}}</ref>
